import outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning
import LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius

open MeasureTheory

namespace outputs.Setups.MuonFrobenius

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

structure Params extends outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.Public

noncomputable abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.Public
  Instance p := Mat p.m p.n → ℝ
  Query p := Mat p.m p.n
  Reply p := Mat p.m p.n
  Output p := Mat p.m p.n
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid p := 0 < p.m ∧ 0 < p.n ∧ 0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.Δ ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f O :=
    LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.FrobeniusSmooth p.L f ∧ BddBelow (Set.range f) ∧
    f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W ≤ p.Δ ∧
    LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.StochasticOracleModel f p.σ O
  successful p f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => nuclearNorm (gradient f (output ω))) (P : Measure _) ∧
    (∫ ω, nuclearNorm (gradient f (output ω)) ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε
  allowedAlgorithm p A := A = outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.frobenius p

attribute [local simp] spec

end outputs.Setups.MuonFrobenius
